examples.purpose: A portfolio allocation, the guide's In context: a Card gives the portfolio label and its explanation, and the chart owns the category comparison. The values are percentages of the portfolio on a shared 0–100 scale (max 100): Small & Mid is 65% now against a recommended 35%, and Large (25%) and Others (10%) have no recommendation. The bar area is 138 px.
examples.jsx:
<Card>
  <Card.Title>Portfolio allocation</Card.Title>
  <Card.SupportText>Current mix compared with the recommended reference</Card.SupportText>
  <AllocationComparisonChart
    data={[
      { label: 'Small & Mid', value: 65, baseline: 35 },
      { label: 'Large', value: 25 },
      { label: 'Others', value: 10 },
    ]}
    max={100}
    height={138}
  />
</Card>

from.quote: A Card can provide the portfolio label and explanation while the chart owns the category comparison.

props.name: data
props.description: The segments to plot, left → right. Each carries its `value`, optional `baseline` and its `label`, so a bar can never drift from its caption.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum value used to scale every bar **and** baseline. Defaults to the largest `value`/`baseline` across `data`. Pass an explicit `max` (e.g. `100` for percentages) for a fixed scale.

props.name: height
props.description: Height in px of the bar area — i.e. the height of a bar whose value equals `max`. Excludes the value/caption label rows. Default: `154`. Default 154, from the component source.

props.name: barWidth
props.description: Width of each pill bar in px. Default: the `segmentIndicator/track/width` token (`28`).

props.name: showLegend
props.description: Show the legend row above the chart. Default: `true`. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: valueLegendLabel
props.description: Legend label for the bar (current) series. Default: `"Current"`. Default "Current", from the component source.

props.name: baselineLegendLabel
props.description: Legend label for the baseline (recommended) series. Default: `"Recommended"`. The baseline legend item only appears when at least one segment defines a `baseline`. Default "Recommended", from the component source.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats numeric `value`/`baseline` into the default labels. Default: `(v) => \`${v}%\``.

props.name: modes
props.description: Design token modes for theming (e.g. `{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }`).

props.name: chartStyle
props.description: Style applied to the bars row.

props.name: legendStyle
props.description: Style applied to the legend row.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessibility label for the whole chart.

props.name: disableTruncation
props.description: When `true`, disables text truncation: the trailing ellipsis (`…`) is never shown and any `numberOfLines` clamp is ignored, so the text wraps to as many lines as it needs even when horizontal space is tight.

modes.name: Appearance / DataViz
